justification: Both required sites are named with their conditions, at line granularity (FileTxnLog.java:602 for the false branch, 380-381 for the dereference, Observer.java:85 for the too-narrow catch). It additionally explains why the client port answers 4lw but hands out no sessions (syncWithLeader never returns, so ObserverZooKeeperServer never starts serving). Its closing sentence calls the ROLLBACK-on-empty-dir the 'proximate defect' and the Observer catch the 'amplifier', which is exactly the two-site split of the upstream patch. Like runs 1 and 5 it writes 'TRUNC/ROLLBACK', i.e. the upstream name survives the rename in the model's vocabulary; not a grading factor.

Observer.java:85 ('catch (IOException e)'), Observer.java:88, Observer.java:96-98 (finally only unregisters JMX)
claimed_branches: 'at FileTxnLog.java:602 the condition if (storedFiles.size() > 0) is false, so createInputArchive is skipped and the field inputStream (declared null at line 522) is never assigned' -> line 381 dereferences null

'Observer.java:85 catch (IOException e) { ... sock.close(); ... } - NullPointerException is a RuntimeException, so this arm is skipped', hence sock.close() at 88 never executes; QuorumPeer.run:962 catches it, 967 returns the peer to LOOKING and the whole path repeats, orphaning one leader-facing socket per attempt

gt_branches: itr.inputStream == null: FileTxnIterator.init() (566-582) finds no log.* file in the configured txnlog dir, so storedFiles stays empty; goToNextLog() (601-608) takes 'if (storedFiles.size() > 0)' as false and returns without calling createInputArchive() (633-639), the only assignment of inputStream

the thrown NullPointerException is a RuntimeException, not an IOException, so the catch at Observer.java:85 does not apply: sock.close() (88) and pendingRevalidations.clear() (94) are skipped (leaked leader connection -> CLOSE_WAIT) and the exception unwinds to QuorumPeer.run's 'case OBSERVING ... catch (Exception e) ... finally { observer.shutdown(); setObserver(null); updateServerState(); }' (957-969) -> LOOKING -> re-elect -> OBSERVING -> same failure forever
